Master merchant reference list — intended to be downloaded from the internet
and placed beside xpence_analyzer.py.

  category_keywords  Built-in keyword → category rules. Evaluated after
                     user_overrides.json 'overrides' and 'merchants' sections.
                     Edit here to add or broaden global keyword matching.

  category_colors    Default hex color per built-in category.

  category_renames   Maps old category names to current ones for migration.

  merchants          Auto-learned per-name mappings from real statement data.
                     Maintained by the community / distributor of this file.
                     User-specific entries live in user_overrides.json instead.

Priority in classify():
  user overrides > user merchants > master merchants > category_keywords > custom_categories > Other
